title: James Randi's million-dollar paranormal challenge

tellings.quote: he had this show where at first he would give you 10 grand if you proved something paranormal would exist.

related.note: Both are about James Randi's paranormal challenge. The stored story claims the prize was really a 30-year payout that Randi judged himself, while this telling presents it as a straightforward cash prize that began at $10,000.

plain: James Randi was a well-known skeptic who ran a challenge offering money to anyone who could prove a paranormal power under test conditions. A magician and researcher named Chris Ramsay told podcast host Jesse Michels that at first Randi offered 10,000 dollars on a show for such proof, and the prize later grew to a million. Ramsay brings it up while questioning how fair the challenge really was.
